scope: Uninstalled enabled managed guest single-run controller and source packaging; no startup units, boot composition, physical QEMU/KVM fixture execution or deployment acceptance

managed_run.behavior: One actual checkpoint/supervisor/lifecycle family; root/native context, existing SH admission, current enabled registry pin, actual ManagedRun guest EX, direct-child supervision, optional one-shot fixture verification, typed guest-owned shutdown and durable checkpoint. Overall success follows all outer cleanup and empty supervisor cleanup errors.
managed_run.native_integration: Actual canonical Admission SH, guest EX, ManagedRun, fork/QMP surrogate, raw wait ownership and checkpoint publication compose successfully, including after shutdown gate closure; new admission refuses. Host/boot/placement and QEMU executable/credential observations are explicitly substituted.
managed_run.failure_cases: Disabled/pin races, tampered or quarantined run, partial publication, fake StoppedRun/Fixture, raw zero without guest SHUTDOWN, process/thread changes, gate/manager failure and every outer cleanup failure refuse success.
managed_run.resolved_efficiency: Healthy 0.2-second loop originally spawned PID1 systemctl query each iteration. It now uses cheap stop flag/QMP/raw child observation; fresh prelaunch/post-fixture/final stop queries remain. Five-poll regression proves query count constant and final PID1 stopping closes gate before QMP stop.
managed_run.limits: Production run duration is unbounded normal service uptime; every planned test remains capped at eight hours. Bounded synchronous fixture verification interrupted by stop is conservative failure/quarantine, not clean acceptance.

limitations: All new controllers remain uninstalled. Systemd units/boot coordinator, aggregate resource admission, activation/RAM recovery and coherent restore remain required.
No actual QEMU guest/KVM or A733 fixture shutdown ran here; fork/QMP surrogate is software orchestration evidence only.
Readonly expected storage and lifecycle pins do not replace actual physical guest execution. Retain firstkvm as manual; use separate disposable managed guest for acceptance.
Five unchanged TOML files reuse native tomllib parse retained in receipts; Ubuntu Python 3.10 has no tomllib.
